tasks.analysis: Extinctions are a natural part of Earth's history. They can result from a variety of causes, such as climate change, habitat loss, and competition with other species. Among the most famous extinction events was the disappearance of nearly all of the dinosaurs 65 million years ago. Today, human activities are accelerating the rate of extinctions, posing a significant threat to biodiversity.
